evidence: The HfCl4 chemisorption reaction was performed in an ALCVD PULSAR 2000 reactor, attached to the Polygon platform. c HfCl4 was heated to approximately 185°C to achieve sufficient vapor pressure for the HfCl4 pulses. Pulse lengths of 0.1 s were applied to saturate the surface. The Hf areal density was measured by total X-ray reflection fluorescence (TXRF) or Rutherford backscattering spectroscopy (RBS).
